ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image there is a horizontal long stick, with an ant above it and a ladybird below it, indicating that they are moving on the same stick. The precise moving distances are given by the problem text. Reasoning: According to the specified method, regard the stick as a number line from the left end 0 to the right end 1. Ant Annie starts from the left end 0 and crawls to the right by \(\frac{2}{3}\) of the stick length, so her final position is \(\frac{2}{3}\). Ladybird Bob starts from the right end 1 and crawls to the left by \(\frac{3}{4}\) of the stick length, so his final position is \(1-\frac{3}{4}=\frac{1}{4}\). The proportion of the stick length between them is the difference of the two coordinates: \(\left|\frac{2}{3}-\frac{1}{4}\right|=\frac{8}{12}-\frac{3}{12}=\frac{5}{12}\).
